summary: Spurs lined up in a 4-3-3 against Leeds's 3-4-2-1 (1 change from the Crystal Palace game, switching from 4-2-3-1).
The result matched the chances: 0.77 xG to 2.02.
On the main style measures this was a typical Spurs performance for the season: nothing moved more than 15% from their average.
Bentancur was the biggest attacking threat (0.39 xG + xA).
